description: Tool to update metadata on a charge's dispute. Use when you need to attach structured information to a dispute for tracking or internal reference purposes.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for updating a charge dispute.

charge.description: The ID of the charge to update the dispute for. Must start with 'ch_'.
charge.title: Charge

metadata.description: Key-value pairs to attach to the dispute for storing structured additional information. Individual keys can be unset by posting an empty value.
metadata.title: Metadata

inputSchema.title: UpdateChargeDisputeRequest

name: update_charge_dispute

BalanceTransaction.description: Balance transaction object related to the dispute.

amount.description: Gross amount of the transaction, in smallest currency unit.
amount.title: Amount

available_on.description: The date the transaction's net funds will become available in the Stripe balance.
available_on.title: Available On

created.description: Time at which the object was created (Unix timestamp).
created.title: Created

currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code, in lowercase.
currency.title: Currency

description.description: An arbitrary string attached to the object.
description.title: Description

id.description: Unique identifier for the balance transaction.
id.title: Id

net.description: Net amount of the transaction, in smallest currency unit.
net.title: Net

BalanceTransaction.title: BalanceTransaction

access_activity_log.description: Any server or activity logs showing proof that the customer accessed or downloaded the purchased digital product.
access_activity_log.title: Access Activity Log

billing_address.description: The billing address provided by the customer.
billing_address.title: Billing Address

cancellation_policy.description: Your subscription cancellation policy, as shown to the customer.
cancellation_policy.title: Cancellation Policy

cancellation_policy_disclosure.description: An explanation of how and when the customer was shown your refund policy prior to purchase.
cancellation_policy_disclosure.title: Cancellation Policy Disclosure

cancellation_rebuttal.description: A justification for why the customer's subscription was not canceled.
cancellation_rebuttal.title: Cancellation Rebuttal

customer_communication.description: Any communication with the customer that you feel is relevant to your case.
customer_communication.title: Customer Communication

customer_email_address.description: The email address of the customer.
customer_email_address.title: Customer Email Address

customer_purchase_ip.description: The IP address that the customer used when making the purchase.
customer_purchase_ip.title: Customer Purchase Ip

customer_signature.description: A relevant document or contract showing the customer's signature.
customer_signature.title: Customer Signature

duplicate_charge_documentation.description: Documentation for the prior charge that can uniquely identify the charge.
duplicate_charge_documentation.title: Duplicate Charge Documentation

duplicate_charge_explanation.description: An explanation of the difference between the disputed charge and the prior charge.
duplicate_charge_explanation.title: Duplicate Charge Explanation

duplicate_charge_id.description: The Stripe ID for the prior charge which appears to be a duplicate of the disputed charge.
duplicate_charge_id.title: Duplicate Charge Id

product_description.description: A description of the product or service that was sold.
product_description.title: Product Description

receipt.description: Any receipt or message sent to the customer notifying them of the charge.
receipt.title: Receipt

refund_policy.description: Your refund policy, as shown to the customer.
refund_policy.title: Refund Policy

refund_policy_disclosure.description: Documentation demonstrating that the customer was shown your refund policy prior to purchase.
refund_policy_disclosure.title: Refund Policy Disclosure

refund_refusal_explanation.description: A justification for why the customer is not entitled to a refund.
refund_refusal_explanation.title: Refund Refusal Explanation

service_date.description: The date on which the customer received or began receiving the purchased service.
service_date.title: Service Date

service_documentation.description: Documentation showing proof that a service was provided to the customer.
service_documentation.title: Service Documentation

shipping_address.description: The address to which a physical product was shipped.
shipping_address.title: Shipping Address

shipping_carrier.description: The delivery service that shipped a physical product.
shipping_carrier.title: Shipping Carrier

shipping_date.description: The date on which a physical product began its route to the shipping address.
shipping_date.title: Shipping Date

shipping_documentation.description: Documentation showing proof that a product was shipped to the customer at the same address the customer provided.
shipping_documentation.title: Shipping Documentation

shipping_tracking_number.description: The tracking number for a physical product.
shipping_tracking_number.title: Shipping Tracking Number

due_by.description: Date by which evidence must be submitted to challenge the dispute. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
due_by.title: Due By

has_evidence.description: Whether evidence has been saved for this dispute.
has_evidence.title: Has Evidence

past_due.description: Whether the last evidence submission was submitted past the due date.
past_due.title: Past Due

submission_count.description: The number of times evidence has been submitted.
submission_count.title: Submission Count

UpdateChargeDisputeResponse.description: Response containing the updated dispute information.

amount.description: Disputed amount in the smallest currency unit (e.g., 100 cents represents $1.00). Usually the amount of the charge, but can differ if partial capture occurred.
amount.title: Amount

balance_transactions.description: List of zero, one, or two balance transactions that show funds withdrawn and reinstated to your Stripe account as a result of this dispute.
balance_transactions.title: Balance Transactions

charge.description: ID of the charge that was disputed.
charge.title: Charge

created.description: Time at which the dispute was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
created.title: Created

currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code, in lowercase.
currency.title: Currency

evidence.description: Evidence provided to respond to a dispute.
evidence.title: Evidence

id.description: Unique identifier for the dispute object.
id.title: Id

is_charge_refundable.description: If true, it is still possible to refund the disputed payment. Once the payment has been fully refunded, no further funds will be withdrawn from your Stripe account as a result of this dispute.
is_charge_refundable.title: Is Charge Refundable

livemode.description: Has the value true if the object exists in live mode or the value false if the object exists in test mode.
livemode.title: Livemode

metadata.description: Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to an object for storing additional structured information.
metadata.title: Metadata

object.description: String representing the object's type. Always 'dispute' for dispute objects.
object.title: Object

payment_intent.description: ID of the PaymentIntent that was disputed, if one exists.
payment_intent.title: Payment Intent

reason.description: Reason given by cardholder for dispute. Possible values are: bank_cannot_process, check_returned, credit_not_processed, customer_initiated, debit_not_authorized, duplicate, fraudulent, general, incorrect_account_details, insufficient_funds, product_not_received, product_unacceptable, subscription_canceled, or unrecognized.
reason.title: Reason

status.description: Current status of dispute. Possible values are: warning_needs_response, warning_under_review, warning_closed, needs_response, under_review, charge_refunded, won, or lost.
status.title: Status

UpdateChargeDisputeResponse.title: UpdateChargeDisputeResponse
